QUESTIONS

Good to know

What exactly do I get?

Every Premium feature above — the 8 exclusive AI indicators, the full liquidation heatmap, Ask-AI on charts (50/day), Balance Mode, premium leaderboards, the Daily Brief, +5% XP, the PRO badge and higher API limits. New Premium tools are added over time at no extra cost.

How do I pay?

In crypto — Bitcoin, USDT or any major coin — through NOWPayments. We never hold a private key or store card details. Access turns on the moment your payment confirms.

Can I cancel?

Yes. Monthly simply doesn't renew if you don't pay again — there's nothing to cancel and no lock-in. Founder is a one-time payment for lifetime access.

Is this financial advice?

No. Everything on MarginPad is educational and for paper trading. The indicators analyse data and will be wrong sometimes — they're an edge, not a guarantee.
